claims: Netflix has officially renewed Virgin River for an eighth season.
Production for Virgin River season 8 is expected to start in Vancouver on April 22, 2026.
Production for Virgin River season 8 is expected to run through August 2026.
Filming for Virgin River season 8 is slated for April 22, 2026, through early August 2026.
Virgin River season 8 will feature a four-month time jump.
Virgin River season 8 will have 10 episodes.
Virgin River season 8 is expected to premiere in spring 2027.
Virgin River season 8 will focus on Mel and Jack facing the challenges of raising a child with special physical needs.
In Virgin River season 8, Jack works on the farm.
In Virgin River season 8, Denny will be applying to medical school.
In Virgin River season 8, a new relationship for Muriel is expected.
Alexandra Breckenridge is returning for Virgin River season 8.
Martin Henderson is returning for Virgin River season 8.
Lauren Hammersley (Charmaine) will not return for Virgin River season 8.
Marco Grazzini (Mike) will not return for Virgin River season 8.
Showrunner Patrick Sean Smith has indicated there are no current plans for Virgin River season 8 to be the final season.
This information is based on reports as of March 2026, following the release of Virgin River Season 7.
